body:
Enchanted Books Extended
> 📖 Description
> 
> Enchanted Books Extended is a simple yet powerful mod that extends all multi-level enchantments up to level 10!

> Ever wanted Sharpness X on your sword? Or Protection X on your armor? Now you can!

> ✨ Features
- Extended Enchantment Levels — All enchantments that normally have multiple levels (like Sharpness, Protection, Efficiency, Unbreaking, etc.) now go up to level 10
- Smart Detection — Single-level enchantments like Mending, Silk Touch, Infinity, Aqua Affinity, Flame, Channeling, and Multishot remain unchanged
- Full Anvil Support — Apply high-level enchantments via anvil without them being capped to vanilla limits
- Creative Tab — New creative tab with all enchanted books from level 1 to 10 for easy access
- Vanilla-Friendly — Works with vanilla enchanting mechanics, just with higher caps
